newsitem.title: CANADA: Brimm Energy plans oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Brimm Energy plans oil deal.

text.p: Brimm Energy Corp, a Canadian distributor and producer of ethanol for the western United States said on Thursday that it plans to acquire the rights to all the international oil and gas projects owned by a British Virgin Islands-based company.
It said a letter of intent signed with privately owned Odyssey International Petroleum Inc, includes the rights to a project in the former Soviet republic of Turkmenistan.
Brimm Energy said it would exchange up to 40 million of its common shares to complete the purchase under the terms of the agreement.
Financing for the deal will be backed in part by an offshore private placement of US$21 million worth of units, Brimm Energy officials said.
